D5/S3/HilbertOperators/UnitaryPowerDilat.signature: theorem exists_unitary_power_dilation (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) : ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup H) (_ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H) (_ : CompleteSpace H) (V : E →L[ℂ] H) (U : H →L[ℂ] H), (∀ x y : E, ⟪V x, V y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ) ∧ U ∈ unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : E), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint V ((U ^ n) (V x)) = (T ^ n) x)
